hook: Pyrolysis during 3D printing cuts lattice error in visible-light photonic crystals about 45-fold.
hook_turn: cuts lattice error in visible-light photonic crystals about 45-fold.
summary: Printing photonic crystals that work at visible wavelengths has been hard because precision and shape freedom trade off. The team added a suspended pyrolysis step to two-photon printing, giving diamond-lattice crystals with a 5.75 nm spread in lattice period and uniform reflection spectra. Results are shown for small printed structures and arrays, not for finished optical devices.
title: Controllable fabrication of visible-spectrum 3D photonic crystals.
